title: Plane-aware Hotpatch & Rollback Handshake for Tenant-Scoped Canary Regressions
creator: Aisha Patel
acceptance_criteria: A deterministic rollback handshake documented and implemented as an API between control planes that supports 'proposed-fix', 'hold', 'apply', 'reconcile', 'abort' states.
Automation that runs a canary triage job: analyzes latency/quality regressions, compares token-level diffs against baseline prompts, and outputs a suggested action within 15 minutes.
KV-cache reconciliation playbook and scripts validated on staging with synthetic replay that demonstrates no persistent stale-state across a cross-plane rollback.
Customer-facing communication templates (initial triage, mitigation notice, post-fix summary) approved by Support & Legal and stored in Confluence.
Runbook steps for Solutions Engineers and Support including exact commands, dashboards links, and escalation matrix verified in a post-run tabletop exercise.
steps: Draft handshake API spec and protobuf/messages; review with control-plane leads (deadline: 2026-03-03).
Implement intermediate 'proposal' state in rollout controller so a plane can vote to accept an outbound hotpatch. (ENG/infra PR: draft).
Create canary-triage lambda that pulls telemetry, runs prompt diffs, and posts verdict to incident channel. (owner: Observability).
Write kv-cache reconciler utility that can: snapshot, purge, and rehydrate client slices safely; add unit/integration tests against synthetic workloads.
Author customer comms and escalation templates; run a legal review and publish to Confluence reference doc.
Run two tabletop drills with Support/SE/SRE simulating a canary regression in Hosted that requires targeted private-plane coordination. Capture timing metrics.
updates: 2026-02-26 - Kickoff: scoping meeting with SRE, Observability, Solutions. Agreed to treat Dedicated/Private as independent voters in handshake. Action: Miguel to draft API contract.
2026-03-02 - API contract v0.1 posted: https://confluence.redwood.ai/pages/rollout-handshake-v0.1. Feedback: need explicit 'reconcile' step for KV cache reconciliation. Assigned to Aisha.
2026-03-05 - Observability team delivered canary triage prototype (Python job). It computes per-prompt token-diff and a signal score. Working on reducing false positives for noisy tenants.

2026-03-09 - KV-cache reconciler POC completed on staging; found a race when a rehydrate coincides with in-flight token requests. Mitigation: short-lived maintenance window with traffic drain before rehydrate. Added to playbook.
2026-03-12 - Draft communication templates submitted to Support & Legal; Legal requested explicit data-retention language for Private deployments. Templates updated.

2026-03-14 - Tabletop #1 run: simulated Hosted canary regression. End-to-end time-to-proposed-fix: 22 minutes (goal was 15). Identified three blockers: notification routing delays, handshake timeouts, and SE runbook clarity. Next: reduce triage duration and harden handshake retries.
